sections.Profile:
"Car Hop" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1991. Part of the Gottlieb System 3 series, it features a diner theme with three flippers, an alphanumeric display, and a single multiball mode. Designed by Jon Norris, with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, David Moore, and Jeanine Mitchell, the game is noted for its nostalgia-driven sound and scoring options. A total of 1,060 units were produced.
